description: Test suite for job management in Mattermost, including job retrieval, permission checks, job creation, cancellation, and deduplication logic.

methods.name: TestGetJob
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a job by ID.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToCreateJob
methods.description: Tests permission checks for creating various jobs based on user roles and permissions.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToCreateAccessControlSyncJob
methods.description: Tests permission logic for creating access control sync jobs for system admins, channel admins, and regular users.

methods.name: TestCreateAccessControlSyncJob
methods.description: Tests job cancellation and creation logic, including handling of pending, in-progress, and completed jobs.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToReadJob
methods.description: Tests permission checks for reading jobs based on user roles and permissions.

methods.name: TestGetJobByType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of jobs filtered by type with pagination.

methods.name: TestGetJobsByTypes
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple jobs filtered by multiple types with pagination.
